title: Covering a symmetric crossing supermodular function with hyperedges of prescribed size

statement.text: Given a symmetric crossing supermodular function <math>p:2^V\to \mathbb{R}</math> and positive integers <math>n_1,n_2,\dots,n_k</math>, does there exist a hypergraph ''H=(V,E)'' covering ''p'' and having exactly ''k'' hyperedges of sizes <math>n_1,n_2,\dots,n_k</math>?

status_observation.evidence: pinned EGRES Open MediaWiki revision and categories
